---

## Two IxP node categories

### 1. `uipath.ixp.*` — Direct IxP Extraction Nodes (13 nodes)
These are published IxP models **deployed to an Orchestrator folder**, usable directly as extraction steps in a flow. All are available on your tenant:

| Display Name | Description |
|---|---|
| **aviation-investigation-final-report-demo** | (Shared) |
| **birth_certificates_oob** | (Shared) |
| **death_certificates_oob** | (Shared) |
| **employment-agreements** | (Shared) |
| **health_insurance_cards_oob** | (Shared) |
| **idp-benchmark---bank-statements** | (Shared) |
| **idp-benchmark---invoices** | (Shared) |
| **idp-benchmark---passports** | (Shared) |
| **idp-benchmark---receipts** | (Shared) |
| **InvoiceIXP** | (Shared) |
| **invoices-billing** | (Shared/uipath-maestro-flow/BillingDispute) |
| **ixp-icao-air-transport-monthly-monitor** | (Shared) |
| **ixp-uniform-residential-loan-application (Fannie Mae 1003)** | (Shared) |

These use the `uipath.ixp.<project-slug>.<project-uuid>-<folder-uuid>` node type pattern and are the nodes you'd add to a flow as an extraction step.

---

### 2. `uipath.agent.resource.tool.ixp.*` — IxP Agent Resource Tools (40 nodes)
These expose IxP models as **tools available to an autonomous agent node** inside a flow, rather than as direct extraction steps. They use the `uipath.agent.resource.tool.ixp.<slug>.<uuid>` pattern. Notable ones include:

| Display Name |
|---|
| Vendor Invoices |
| IDP Benchmark - Bank Statements / Invoices / Passports / Receipts |
| ap-invoices |
| invoices-billing |
| invoice-lifecycle |
| My Invoices |
| health_insurance_cards_oob |
| birth_certificates_oob / death_certificates_oob |
| employment-agreements |
| ixp-uniform-residential-loan-application (Fannie Mae 1003) |
| (plus various test/codereval projects) |

---

## Which to use

| Goal | Node type prefix |
|---|---|
| Add a document-extraction step directly in the flow | `uipath.ixp.*` |
| Give an agent the ability to call an IxP model as a tool | `uipath.agent.resource.tool.ixp.*` |

To get the exact `NodeType` string for a specific model (needed to add it to a flow), run:
```bash
uip maestro flow registry search "<model name>" --output json --output-filter "[?starts_with(NodeType, 'uipath.ixp.')].{NodeType:NodeType,DisplayName:DisplayName}"
```

  # Inverted check: a listing/Q&A task should NOT create a .flow file.

  - type: run_command
    description: "No .flow file was created (listing is read-only Q&A, not a build task)"
    command: '! find . -name "*.flow" -type f | grep -q .'
    expected_exit_code: 0
    suite_thresholds: {mean: 0.85}
